How to Never Miss a Customer Call Again

It’s a problem businesses of all sizes face: a missed call, something that can be reduced or eliminated by the power of technology, including after-hours coverage. Every missed customer call is a lost business opportunity and a hit to your reputation.

When no one answers the phone, every customer call is a missed first win. In this article, we’ve covered how missed customer calls have a big impact, why calls get missed, and what to do about it with transcription services, the right voicemail messages to leave, and the ability to answer your phone for good.

AI Voice Agent has the perfect answer to never having to miss a customer call again.

Understanding Missed Calls

The Impact of Missed Customer Calls on Small Businesses

One missed customer call is as good as lost business for small companies, since not all businesses get a steady stream of calls. It is especially important to respond to customer inquiries during high-volume periods quickly.

When a call is missed, the result can be disastrous to the customer’s perception of your small business and productivity, particularly since they will not leave a message if the phone is not answered quickly.

One missed call can equate to one lost sale, one irritated customer, and one potential bad recommendation from one pissed-off customer if it takes too long for a business to call them back, creating a poor customer experience.

Small businesses often don’t have the luxury of staffing a customer service representative to pick up the phone at all hours, which means there is an increased need for an “on-call” method to handle the extreme hours, along with your normal hours of operation.

One missed customer call could be anything from a question about a new job to a client seeking out your services, or simply a reason to call the competition because your customer service is lacking.

Common Reasons for Unanswered Calls

There are many reasons why a customer call can go unanswered. Often, though, the causes are operational hurdles small businesses face daily, which stop them from taking a call, which can ultimately negatively affect how they communicate with their customers.

Examples can include not having enough staff on hand; in times of high demand, a business doesn’t have enough staff to spread around to be able to answer the phones, and therefore, calls are unanswered, and/or go to voicemail, or are dropped.

It could be that the owner and their staff are too busy with clients who have come into the business, on the phone to suppliers or colleagues, or working on other demanding jobs to be able to answer every call, and this increases the chances of missing a call.

If the business is not open during times when a customer happens to call, this can lead to an unanswered call, such as outside of the defined service hours. Technical problems with the phone system, mismanagement of an answering service, or simply human error can also cause calls to go unanswered and frustrate customers who feel that they are just being ignored.

Statistics on Missed Calls and Customer Retention

The information presented shows clearly how negatively missed calls impact customer retention and the growth of the business, and demonstrates the importance of calling them back within seconds and limiting missed opportunities.

There is research that consistently shows upwards of 50% of callers will not leave a message for their unanswered call, hang up, and will often call a competitor, again emphasizing the importance of getting to the caller before the voicemail picks up, which reduces missed opportunities.

As the client is expecting communication in today’s society, if they view your unavailability by way of your unanswered call, then the impatience of the customer limits your chances of calling that customer back; you miss their call, in turn losing their loyalty and their custom to a competitor that can pick up the phone.

Figures show that many of the likely customers you phone will not call you back if your first attempt to do so results in your voicemail service. This results in poor customer communication, which affects your development both in new leads and in attracting current customers.

Repeat callers tend to expect near-instant customer service when calling, along with the knowledge of what they want, especially when they know they won’t leave a message,hence the opportunity for missed opportunities gets decreased.

A larger and larger number of missed calls can have a huge effect on the customer experience and can make it much more difficult to attract and retain existing customers. Difficulty gaining and retaining customers can impact the growth of the small business.

Implementing an AI Voice Agent

An introduction to voice agent:

AI Voice Agent Skadi is a major step in automated customer care, allowing businesses never to miss a customer call again and maximize their touchpoints. This new automated answering service is built on an artificial intelligence agent that acts as a virtual answering service by mimicking human-like intelligibility in handling incoming calls.

Skadi is more than just a voice mailbox; it is a helpful assistant that gets to know the purpose of your phone call.

Deploying Skadi allows small businesses to address the common dilemma of unanswered customer calls while providing a professional service, no matter the call volume or whether staff are available. The fundamental goal is to provide an educated answer and make the customer experience better in less than a minute.

How AI Voice Agent Addresses Missed Calls

AI Voice Agent Skadi addresses the missed call issue in a number of different ways, giving your business a new way to handle incoming customer calls and increasing your chances of reaching new and prospective customers.

If no employee receives a call, an AI Voice robot will respond immediately, saving the caller from waiting on a voicemail message. The caller could be presented with one or a combination of options like: a callback from a real person during regular working hours. In both cases, the caller gets a response.

Responding to a missed call, whether your staff can’t get to the phone or not, or even if a business owner can’t, the caller is always answered and is always given information that must be escalated to another human or to someone at a later time (i.e., view your calendar for times).

Benefits of Using AI for Call Management

Using AI for call management, such as Skadi, offers myriad benefits to your business, for both your bottom line and your customer experience, helping your business to stop missing customer calls.

First and foremost, AI will ensure you don’t miss your call,l and your customer won’t miss theirs by not only booking the appointment for you without delay, but also answering the phone all the time (something a human cannot manage with the few to hundreds of calls they might be handling each day), reducing wait times and never missing a customer call.

You will never miss a call that’s money in the bank, potential customers at the door, and existing customers always happy to have their calls answered and their needs met.

With AI, you automate before you even get to speak with your customer, freeing your staff up for more complex considerations while keeping them free of the stress and inefficiency of hundreds of calls per day and ensuring the phone rings for you every time.

Additionally, AI will analyze call trends and customer needs to help you get the most out of every caller, improving the customer experience while fine-tuning your marketing, sales, and customer service efforts.

Advanced Features for Business Owners

Missed Call Text Back Functionality

One of the most impressive features of the AI Voice Agent is the amazing missed call text back feature for businesses to be able to call the next customer back fast. This function is perfect for any business to never miss any customers’ calls.

The missed call to text back allows businesses to not let the call forward to voicemail after a busy period, but instead to send a customizable range of SMS texts to the caller instantly, such as “sorry we missed your call”.

This offers the customer options such as creating a link to some information, a callback time, or asking them to reply to the text with their enquiry.

This makes sure that even if the business owner and their staff are not able to answer the call immediately, the customer will get a response instantly, and the business will be much more likely to generate the customer quote and not lose the business to a more customer-friendly competitor with better callback options.

Call Forwarding and Routing Solutions

However, AI Voice Agent does work well as a tool to have intelligent call forwarding and routing, which is essential for small businesses never to miss a customer call, especially when tackling robocalls.

It enables businesses to set advanced rules as to how incoming customer calls are routed, which means you stop missing customer calls, and every call is answered within seconds. For example, calls can be forwarded to certain departments or department personnel according to the caller’s question, hour, or the caller ID of the call, so that you do not miss out on the call.

If a call is unanswered from the primary recipient, it can be automatically transferred to another number, preventing it from going to voicemail and being forwarded back to a call center.

It’s also an intelligent way of routing a business’s total calls to the most relevant person or department while the employee is working at home, and ensuring that every customer gets their calls answered. Moreover, it helps to prevent missed calls that often occur by ensuring every caller gets a quick answer to every one of their calls.

24/7 Availability with After-Hours Support

Many small businesses face the challenge of providing 24/7 customer service Mainly when they operate on a 9-5 basis. As an outcome, unanswered phone calls result in lost business In particular on those rare occasions when you are dealing with another customer, or doing on-site work.

The good news is that with Skadi's AI-powered voice phone agent, you have an all-in-one assistant that will be picking up all your incoming calls at 24/7, any day, any hour. It can not only greet the caller, but also provide information on routine questions while it also collects customer details so that it can then book the appointments or even schedule a callback, without any requirement of a hiring of a part-time assistant to cover outside of the business hours or the use of voicemail.

Customers can talk with the AI voice assistant when the team of your business is not there or away, which means they no longer have to get a machine recording and voicemail. If the issue cannot be handled through an immediate resolution or if the issue is a complex one, the customer can choose to have a callback at a time that suits them best or the inquiry can be left to your team to handle if there is no option. This is what will lead to a quick and polite handling of each customer, which will at the same time present a great professional image, not a few missed business opportunities are going to happen.

Optimizing Call Handling Strategies

Effective Staff Training for Answering Services

Of course, despite all the advanced AI technology solutions, staff training is arguably one of the most important factors in optimizing call handling and ensuring small businesses can pick up the phone, and there is no customer call going to voicemail.

For example, although AI Voice Agent handles the high volume of initial customer calls, human presence is still required to address in-depth questions, close sales, and build stronger customer relationships.

Training should include providing knowledge, training, and skills on integration with the AI Voice agent, when to take over, call analytics on how to use the analytics from the call, and how to do a callback triggered by the AI Voice agent missed call text back.

Training your staff to optimize leveraging AI tools will help lower the number of unanswered calls, improve customer experience, and ensure that every call is answered productively instead of being directed to voicemail.

Integrating Outbound Call Solutions

Implementing outbound calling solutions is another step that every small business can take to never miss a customer call and stay proactive with the right technology.

While Call agent will efficiently cater to a business’s incoming inquiries, to capitalize on the business’s inbound efforts, all the prospects that Skadi brings in, i.e., required callback, are tracked and delivered on by systems that enable an employee to gain access to the information of the call that Voice call agent answered and get on a return call for missed calls in real time, without any voicemails.

Outbound solutions can also be leveraged proactively by following up on a query or keeping the customer updated and in the loop so they always know what to expect back from you. It closes the communication loop and lends a proactive touch, so the customer is always kept hooked to the premise of a business.

Utilizing Dialing Technology for Better Customer Engagement

The utilization of best-in-class dialing technology is a necessity for any small business wishing to enhance the quality of its customer engagement and more effectively manage call volume so they never miss a customer call.

While many modern dialing solutions are capable of simple call forwarding, coupling these solutions with advanced AI Voice Agent can allow scheduling for contact backs, more intelligent call queue management, and call analytics.

When a business representative makes a contact back to a customer who previously interacted with an AI Voice Call Agent. The representative will have all the context and information from that interaction, enabling them to carry out a much more personalized and effective call experience (for example, if the call goes unanswered, the technology could quickly determine that contact is required and that a contact-back call is scheduled by an agent, or for after hours could be scheduled for the following business day).

This technology considerably decreases the chance of a missed call while greatly improving the customer interaction experience.
